title: Hadoop and Spark baseline at 10K works
purpose: Baseline run of the bounded pipeline (Hadoop HJ1-HJ7 then Spark) on dblp-10k at minimum EMR capacity: input and output records, task counts, duration, shuffle, failures and estimated cost.

environment.note: Terraform output region; no AWS call is made by this manifest.

command_notes: Needs AWS_PROFILE, AWS_REGION=us-east-2 and a packaged release (scripts/package.sh) from a clean tree.

HUMAN APPROVAL EDIT (same step as setting approved and approved_by): append to the command array "--dblp-xml", "<file>", "--dtd", "<file>", "--enrichment-dir", "<dir>" (as in datasets/scripts/FETCH-SCALE.md) (the script exits 2 without the first three). Appending arguments to this array is a manifest edit by the human, not a change by experiment-engineer.

scripts/run-experiment.sh runs this command verbatim (no extra arguments) and does not export its run id. The pipeline script therefore generates its own run id; its record is reports/pipeline/10k/<generated id>/run.json (use that id as --run-id of the collectors). The run-experiment.sh run id names only reports/experiments/<id>/<run>/.
The load and enqueue stages are not run here (M13-2, no EMR entry point).

scripts/run-experiment.sh refuses unless approved is true and approved_by is non-empty: the human edits those two fields, and it refuses a dirty tree: commit the raw results of any previous experiment first (experiments/README.md, Between experiments).

cost_estimate.basis: INFRA-CONTRACTS.md section 10: a 10K run is about $1.33 of EMR (cluster about $0.76 per hour, 3 nodes m5.xlarge on-demand)

dataset_snapshot.notes: 10K selection, policy-1 index reused unchanged (see manifest limitations)

metrics_to_collect: hadoop-counters:input records, output records, rejected records, map and reduce task counts, shuffle bytes (from step logs in the logs bucket; PipelineDriver counters)
spark-event-log:task counts, shuffle read/write bytes, failed tasks (EMR logs in the logs bucket)
cost-explorer:daily UnblendedCost by SERVICE, credits excluded (collect_cost.py)
stop_conditions: any step exceeds 3600 s (pipeline script cancels it)
cumulative cost of this run reaches the cost cap (3.00 USD): stop and report to the human
a step ends FAILED: ActionOnFailure=TERMINATE_CLUSTER; keep the failed run and report it
reproduction: bash scripts/run-experiment.sh exp-a-baseline-10k --run-id <token> (after the human sets approved and approved_by and appends --dblp-xml/--dtd/--enrichment-dir to command); then python3 -B experiments/collect/collect_emr.py, collect_cloudwatch.py and collect_cost.py for the run window with --experiment-id exp-a-baseline-10k and the pipeline's generated run id; analysis: experiments/analysis/emr_capacity.py, scale_comparison.py
